title: Backend Engineer, Payments
description:
Quayside Pay moves money for small shops across the EU. Our payments team runs the settlement ledger that books every card and bank transfer.

What you will do
- Build and run Java services on Spring Boot that book payments to the ledger.
- Design REST APIs for our merchant dashboard and for partner banks.
- Move payment events between services with Kafka and keep the data consistent.
- Tune PostgreSQL queries and add Redis caches where they help.

What we ask
- 2 to 4 years of backend work in Java.
- Experience with Spring Boot, REST APIs and a relational database.
- Good habits with tests and code review.

Nice to have: Kafka, Docker, AWS.

We work in English. We offer visa sponsorship and a relocation budget for people who join from outside the EU.
